entities.summary: Major-General Hinrich Ernst Peymann was a Danish army officer who served in the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars. He commanded Danish forces during the Battle of Copenhagen in 1807. He signed the Danish capitulation at Hellerupgård on 9 September 1807.
